forumThreads.title: Clarification on Docker vs. Kubernetes in Module 4
forumThreads.question: Hi professor, I'm confused about when to use Docker standalone vs. Kubernetes in production. The lecture mentions containerizing with Docker first, then orchestration. Could you clarify the exact team size or workload threshold where Kubernetes becomes necessary?

responses.author: Priya Sharma
responses.text: From what I understood, Docker is for building/packaging the image, while K8s manages multiple replicas across nodes.

responses.author: Dr. Aarav Sharma
responses.text: Kubernetes becomes beneficial when managing clusters of 5+ microservices across multiple availability zones.

forumThreads.title: Flutter's setState vs. Riverpod — which to use?
forumThreads.question: Should we use setState or Riverpod for a mid-size commercial app? The module covered both but didn't give a clear recommendation for enterprise Flutter apps.

responses.author: Dr. Aarav Sharma
responses.text: For localized ephemeral widget state (like toggles or text inputs), setState is sufficient. For global application state, authentication, and dependency injection in commercial apps, Riverpod or BLoC is strongly recommended.
